# PromptShield · AI Safety Suite (promptshield)

> One install, your agent stops leaking secrets and obeying injected instructions. A bilingual methodology collection over 9 published agent-runtime-safety sub-skills: red-team → injection shield → leak scan → runtime guard → admission gate.

`promptshield` is a *methodology collection* for agent runtime safety — one repo, one `SKILL.md` orchestrator, multi-vendor plugin shims, and a one-page ASCII lifecycle map. It ships theory (LGD three laws) + skills + evidence chain + admission gates as one auditable unit. It references sub-skills by slug only; internals are not vendored.

## Core

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/SKILL.md): main orchestration (bilingual EN-first)
- [scripts/promptshield_flow.py](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/scripts/promptshield_flow.py): read-only router (`--list` / `--route <stage>`)
- [README.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/README.md): bilingual overview + one-page lifecycle
- [install.sh](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/install.sh) / [install.ps1](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/install.ps1): one-click installer

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/AGENTS.md): work guidance for AI agents
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/llms-full.txt): full text for long-context models
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/SECURITY.md): security policy
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/promptshield/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution guide
